description: Retro-fit signature-ornament survey of bespoke landmarks (scripts/landmarks/ornament-inventory.ts). Judged 2026-10-13 from artifacts/ornament-inventory/<id>/review.jpg: camera-matched panorama (Gemeente Amsterdam, CC BY 4.0) next to the render, the four longest exposed walls per landmark. Schema src/canalRecall/landmarks/ornamentInventory.ts.
